meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 装上后 NanoClaw 会多一个叫 OpenCode 的运行后台,智能体可改用 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等不同厂商的模型。技能自动复制代码、装依赖、重建镜像;装好的文件归它管,手动改会被覆盖。
howto.when: 当你想让某个分组用 OpenCode 作为代理提供方(命令:ncl groups config update --provider opencode),或预检发现相关文件未装齐时,会执行此技能。

say.text: 把 OpenCode 装成可用的代理提供方,并跑一遍全部检查。
say.note: 会自动复制代码、装依赖并重建镜像。

say.text: 在 .env 里配好 OpenRouter 模型,并注册对应 API 密钥。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw can use OpenCode as an agent provider, letting agents call DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc. via OpenCode config. The skill copies files, installs pinned deps, and rebuilds the image.
howto.when_en: Runs when the user wants an agent group to use OpenCode as its provider (e.g. ncl groups config update --provider opencode), or when the pre-flight check finds OpenCode files missing.

say_en.text: Install OpenCode as an agent provider and run all the checks.
say_en.note: Copies files, installs deps, rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Switch this group to opencode with deepseek/deepseek-chat.
say_en.note: Changes provider and restarts; memory won't carry over.

say_en.text: Set up OpenRouter as the model source in .env and register its API key.
say_en.note: Writes OPENCODE_MODEL and registers the secret with onecli.
